feat: Add Firebase Cloud Functions for Phase 2

## Summary
- Implemented 7 core Cloud Functions for YOLOSEUM platform
- Automated leaderboard updates, ROI calculations, profit distribution
- Comprehensive data backup and archival system

## Cloud Functions Implemented

### 1. updateLeaderboard
- Triggers: Every hour (Pub/Sub)
- Updates weekly & monthly leaderboards
- Ranks strategies by ROI, TVL, performance metrics
- Auto-generates period metadata

### 2. calculateROI
- Triggers: On strategy data changes (Firestore)
- Real-time ROI calculation
- Updates trader performance metrics
- Calculates Sharpe Ratio

### 3. distributeProfit
- Triggers: Daily at midnight
- Distributes profits to supporters
- Calculates profit shares based on investment ratio
- Applies 20% platform fee
- Creates transaction records

### 4. validateTrader
- Triggers: HTTP callable (Admin only)
- Verifies trader credentials
- Updates verification status
- Supports approval/rejection with reasons

### 5. sendNotification
- Triggers: On transaction creation
- Sends user notifications
- Supports multiple notification types
- Auto-cleanup after 30 days

### 6. backupData
- Triggers: Daily at 2AM
- Backs up all collections to Cloud Storage
- Saves metadata with backup info
- Auto-cleanup old backups (30+ days)

### 7. archiveOldData
- Triggers: Monthly on 1st at 3AM
- Archives old transactions (90+ days)
- Archives reviews (180+ days)
- Cloud Storage archival
- Restore capability included

## Technical Details
- Node.js 18 compatible
- Firebase Admin SDK
- Batch operations for performance
- Error handling and logging
- Type-safe operations

## File Structure
```
functions/
├── package.json
├── index.js (Main entry point)
└── src/
    ├── updateLeaderboard.js (Weekly/Monthly rankings)
    ├── calculateROI.js (Real-time calculations)
    ├── distributeProfit.js (Daily profit sharing)
    ├── validateTrader.js (Admin verification)
    ├── sendNotification.js (Event notifications)
    ├── backupData.js (Automated backups)
    └── archiveOldData.js (Data archival)
```

## Deployment
```bash
cd functions
npm install
firebase deploy --only functions
```

## Next Steps
- Deploy to Firebase project
- Set up Cloud Scheduler triggers
- Configure environment variables
- Add unit tests
- Monitor function execution

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
